publicTrust.statusPageSubtitle: How we think about uptime, monitoring, and where to look when something breaks.
publicTrust.statusBullet1: The panel and API are designed for continuous operation behind your reverse proxy and containers.
publicTrust.statusBullet2: Load balancers and uptime checks can call the lightweight JSON health endpoint on the same host.
publicTrust.statusBullet3: For human-readable incident notes and maintenance windows, join the support Discord linked in the footer.

publicTrust.securityPageSubtitle: High-level overview of how Deveng handles access and data when you use the bot and dashboard.
publicTrust.securityBullet1: Dashboard access uses Discord OAuth; bot tokens and access tokens stay on the server, not in localStorage.
publicTrust.securityBullet2: Bot invites use granular permission masks instead of Administrator so you can audit what the bot can do.
publicTrust.securityBullet3: Paid activation is not offered through deveng.app; we therefore do not handle card-holder data flows in this product surface.
publicTrust.securityBullet4: Privacy, cookies, and GDPR/KVKK notices describe retention, logging, and lawful bases — read them alongside this page.
publicTrust.securityBullet5: Public pages and the management panel are served over HTTPS (TLS).

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how the Deveng management panel uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.
cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. They help us keep you signed in, remember preferences (such as theme or language), and protect the service.
cookies.s2Body: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication and security (for example, session cookies after Discord sign-in). We may use preference cookies for UI settings such as theme, layout, and language. We do not use third-party advertising cookies on the panel.
cookies.s3Body: We may store certain preferences in browser local storage (for example, selected language) to improve performance. You can clear these through your browser settings.
cookies.s4Body: Most browsers let you refuse or delete cookies. If you block strictly necessary cookies, parts of the panel (including sign-in) may not work correctly.
cookies.s5Body: We may update this Cookie Policy when our practices change. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised policy.
cookies.s6Body: Cookie or privacy questions: privacy@deveng.global. General operational support: support@deveng.global.

gdpr.title: GDPR Notice
gdpr.intro: This notice summarizes how Deveng Bot processes personal data in connection with the Services for users in the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, and Switzerland, in addition to our Privacy Policy.
gdpr.s1Body: The data controller for personal data processed through the Services is Deveng Bot. Contact: privacy@deveng.global
gdpr.s2Body: We process data based on: performance of a contract (providing the Services you request); legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention, product improvement balanced against your rights); consent where required (for example, non-essential cookies if we add them); legal obligations where applicable.
gdpr.s3Body: We may process Discord account identifiers, email if provided by Discord, guild and role information necessary to authorize dashboard access, technical logs (IP, user agent) for security, and configuration data you save in the panel. deveng.app does not expose paid activation flows, so payment-card data collection is out of scope for the current product surface.
gdpr.s4Body: If data is processed outside your country, we use appropriate safeguards where required (such as standard contractual clauses) or rely on adequacy decisions.
gdpr.s5Body: We retain data only as long as needed to provide the Services, comply with law, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Server configuration may be removed when you delete it or close your use of the Services.
gdpr.s6Body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, or object to certain processing, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To exercise rights, contact privacy@deveng.global.
gdpr.s7Body: We may update this GDPR Notice when our processing or the law changes.

faq.pageSubtitle: Answers about the Deveng bot, panel, safety, and support.
faq.c1q1: How do I add Deveng to my server?
faq.c1a1: Use the "Add to Discord" button on our homepage or the invite link we provide. Authorize the bot with the requested permissions so features you enable can work correctly.
faq.c1q2: Why does the bot ask for permissions?
faq.c1a2: Features like moderation, channels, roles, or messages need matching Discord permissions. You can review permissions before approving the invite.
faq.c1q3: How do I open the management panel?
faq.c1a3: Click "Sign in with Discord" on the homepage and authorize access. You will only manage servers where you have the required access and where the bot is present.
faq.c1q4: Do I need administrator on my server?
faq.c1a4: You need sufficient Discord permissions to configure channels, roles, and messages the bot will use. Administrator is not always required, but many setups need broad manage permissions.
faq.c1q5: Can I use Deveng on multiple servers?
faq.c1a5: Yes. Configure each server separately from the panel after selecting the server context.
faq.c1q6: What is the help server link?
faq.c1a6: Join https://discord.gg/deveng-bot for community help and announcements.
faq.c1q7: How do I contact official support by email?
faq.c1a7: Email support@deveng.global for account, account, or legal questions.
faq.c1q8: Does the bot work if Discord has an outage?
faq.c1a8: If Discord is down, bot features may be unavailable until Discord restores service.
faq.c1q9: Can I remove the bot later?
faq.c1a9: Yes. You can remove the bot from your server in Discord at any time. Panel access to that server may stop working until the bot is re-invited.
faq.c1a10: Server configuration you save is stored in Deveng Bot systems backing the API used by the bot and panel.
faq.c2a1: The panel lists modules such as welcome, goodbye, embed messages, polls, giveaways, tickets, music, leveling, moderation tools, logging, and more depending on your plan.
faq.c2a2: Yes. Discord and our infrastructure may enforce rate limits to prevent abuse. Heavy automation or spam may be throttled.
faq.c2q3: Can I customize messages and embeds?
faq.c2a3: Many modules let you set custom text, embeds, and placeholders described in each feature page.
faq.c2a4: Where offered, custom bots run under your Discord application with your token. You are responsible for securing that token and complying with Discord policies.
faq.c2q5: What languages does the panel support?
faq.c2a5: The panel supports multiple UI languages selectable in the interface. Bot responses depend on how you configure each module.
faq.c2q6: Can I restrict who can change settings?
faq.c2a6: Use Discord roles and the panel's authentication model. Only users authorized for a server should change configuration.
faq.c2a7: No. We may change, deprecate, or limit features to maintain stability, security, or compliance.
faq.c2a8: We strive for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. See our Terms of Use for warranty disclaimers.
faq.c2a9: Contact privacy@deveng.global for data-related requests. Export options in-product may vary by feature.
faq.c2q10: How do I report a bug?
faq.c2a10: Use the help server or email support@deveng.global with steps to reproduce and your server ID if relevant.
faq.c3q1: Does Deveng charge for the panel through deveng.app?
faq.c3a1: No. Paid activation is disabled; feature access is governed by in-product limits and operational policies.
faq.c3q2: How do I request a VAT or corporate invoice?
faq.c3a2: Email support@deveng.global with your details. There is no automated invoice flow in the panel today.
faq.c3q3: Do you offer refunds for digital services?
faq.c3a3: Because paid activation is discontinued, new refund cases should be rare. Legitimate historical requests are handled case-by-case via support@deveng.global.
faq.c3a4: Not for in-panel purchases; there is no recurring account product exposed in the dashboard.
faq.c3q5: What happens if I lose access to a module?
faq.c3a5: Check the module quota in the panel, bot permissions, or Discord outages. Support can help triage with your server ID.
faq.c3q6: Can partner organizations get onboarding help?
faq.c3a6: Yes — contact support@deveng.global to coordinate enablement or integrations.
faq.c3a7: Features are available under the published limits without a separate trial SKU.
faq.c3a8: No tax is collected through the panel activation because activation is not enabled. Other Deveng engagements may have their own tax treatment.
faq.c3q9: Can I move settings between Discord servers?
faq.c3a9: Use the Server Backup / import flows where available; there is no entitlement transfer marketplace in the panel.
faq.c3a10: Discord automation and the deveng.app panel are operated by Deveng Bot. Operational questions go to support@deveng.global; privacy requests to privacy@deveng.global.
faq.c4a1: Email support@deveng.global with evidence and identifiers. For user safety emergencies, also use Discord's reporting tools.
faq.c4a2: The bot processes data needed for enabled features (for example, commands, logs, automations you configure). Do not use features to spy on users unlawfully.
faq.c4a3: Illegal content, harassment, hate, sexual content involving minors, malware distribution, and other violations of law or Discord policy are prohibited.
faq.c4q4: Will you terminate service for violations?
faq.c4a4: We may suspend or terminate access if we reasonably believe you violated law, Discord policy, or our terms.
faq.c4q5: How do I handle GDPR requests from my members?
faq.c4a5: As a server operator, you may be a controller for your community data. We assist as a processor where applicable; contact privacy@deveng.global for coordination.
faq.c4a6: Retention depends on your configuration and our infrastructure policies. Minimize sensitive logging.
faq.c4q7: Can I comply with COPPA or age rules?
faq.c4a7: You are responsible for your audience. Do not use the Services in ways that violate age or child-protection rules in your jurisdiction.
faq.c4a8: We do not run your community. Automated actions come from settings you enable.
faq.c4q9: What if someone raids my server?
faq.c4a9: Use Discord moderation tools and your configured automations. Report coordinated abuse to Discord and to us if it targets our infrastructure.
faq.c4q10: How do I secure moderator accounts?
faq.c4a10: Require 2FA for moderators, limit admin roles, and audit bot permissions regularly.
faq.c5a1: Sessions can expire for security, cookie clearing, or password resets. Sign in again with Discord.
faq.c5q2: I cannot see my server in the panel.
faq.c5a2: Ensure you are logged into the correct Discord account, that you still have access to the server, and that the bot is in the server.
faq.c5a3: Redirects must match the Discord application settings configured by Deveng Bot. If you self-host a fork, verify redirect URLs.
faq.c5a4: This FAQ describes the hosted Deveng product. Self-hosted deployments are outside standard support unless separately agreed.
faq.c5a5: Use a current version of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari. Disable extensions that block cookies if sign-in fails.
faq.c5a6: Retry later and contact support if the issue persists. Include timestamps and request IDs if shown.
faq.c5a7: Submit a request to privacy@deveng.global. We will respond subject to verification and legal requirements.
faq.c5a8: No. See our Privacy Policy for how we process data.
faq.c5q9: How do I enable RTL for Arabic?
faq.c5a9: The panel sets direction automatically for Arabic when you have not forced another direction in settings.
faq.c5q10: Where are terms and privacy documents?
faq.c5a10: Use the footer links for Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, GDPR Notice, and EULA.

about.title: About us
about.intro: About the Deveng Bot Discord automation service and management panel.
about.s1Body: Deveng Bot is a Discord automation service developed and operated by Deveng. Deveng is an engineering team delivering production-grade software across mobile, web, terminal, and SDK projects. Deveng Bot extends that experience for Discord communities: it is designed to help you manage your server—with moderation, music, support tickets, automation, leveling, and related needs—from a single panel.
about.s2Body: Add the bot to your server and manage settings at deveng.app. Advanced modules are subject to fair-use quotas rather than in-panel card activation. To learn about Deveng's other products and capabilities, visit deveng.global.
about.s3Body: You sign in to the panel with your Discord account; how we process account and personal data is described in our Privacy Policy. Panel traffic is protected with HTTPS. Payment-card handling is not part of deveng.app today. Supporting legal documents remain linked from the footer for transparency.
about.s4Body: General support: support@deveng.global · Privacy and personal data: privacy@deveng.global · Community: https://discord.gg/deveng-bot
